items.title: Cummins Shares Slide After Earnings Miss Offsets Record Revenue
items.summary: Cummins Inc. (NYSE:CMI) shares fell more than 8% after the engine manufacturer reported second-quarter 2026 results that featured record revenue but earnings below Wall Street expectations.

items.title: Here's What Key Metrics Tell Us About Cummins (CMI) Q2 Earnings
items.summary: While the top- and bottom-line numbers for Cummins (CMI) give a sense of how the business performed in the quarter ended June 2026, it could be worth looking at how some of its key metrics compare to Wall Street estimates and year-ago values.

items.title: Cummins falls 8% as earnings miss overshadows revenue beat
items.summary: Investing.com -- Cummins Inc (NYSE:CMI) reported second-quarter results that missed earnings expectations despite beating revenue estimates, as higher incentive compensation weighed on profitability.

items.title: Cummins (CMI) Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates
items.summary: Cummins (CMI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -5.32% and +1.38%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Cummins Raises Outlook as Profit, Sales Climb
items.summary: Cummins raised its outlook for the year after reporting higher profit and sales in the second quarter, boosted by accelerating orders for standby power for data centers, as well as improving North American truck markets.

items.title: Cummins (NYSE:CMI) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q2 CY2026 But Stock Drops
items.summary: Engine manufacturer Cummins (NYSE:CMI) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 9.4% year on year to $9.46 billion. Its GAAP profit of $6.73 per share was 6.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: How Generac's $1.6 Billion Data Center Backlog Changes Its Outlook
items.summary: Generac's $1.6 billion data center backlog boosts revenue visibility, but capacity execution and a lower-margin C&I mix will shape the payoff.

items.title: Should You Buy Generac as Data Center Growth Tests Its Valuation?
items.summary: Generac's data center-led C&I surge and stronger cash flow support growth, but residential weakness and capacity spending test its valuation.
